description: This file is an HTML document implementing a web-based database viewer interface. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript code for browsing databases, tables, and data, including dynamic fetching and rendering of database content.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases available.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Clears current selection and reloads the list of databases.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from data array and inserts into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates a table cell HTML depending on value type and length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded view of cell content displaying full data.
